1850 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
09-02-1850 minus 194 days:  
194 days = 6 months + 13 days (Jan 31, Dec 31, Nov 30, Oct 31, Sep 30, Aug 31, plus July 31? Let's count precisely).

Back 31 more days → 1849-12-31 (total 40 days).  
Back 31 more → 1849-11-30 (71 days).  
Back 30 more → 1849-10-31 (101 days).  
Back 31 more → 1849-09-30 (132 days).  
Back 30 more → 1849-08-31 (162 days).  
Back 31 more → 1849-07-31 (193 days).  
Need 1 more day back → 1849-07-30.
